description: One order whose delivery territory disagrees with the branch that actually shipped it, or whose territory was never resolved. The branch is the fact; the territory is what needs correcting.

fields.description: The order this exception was raised against.
fields.label: Sales Invoice

fields.description: Branch Territory Mismatch: the POS Profile that shipped is not the POS Profile the invoice's Territory points at. Territory Unresolved: the invoice carries no usable Territory at all.
fields.label: Exception Type

fields.description: Territory Corrected = the Territory (or the Territory's POS Profile) was fixed. Accepted = the crossing was deliberate. Ignored = not worth acting on.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Which lane created the order. Woo when the invoice carries a WooCommerce source type or transaction id, otherwise POS.
fields.label: Order Lane

fields.description: Set on Woo-lane branch mismatches. A Woo order derives its POS Profile FROM Territory.pos_profile at creation, so a later disagreement means the Territory was re-pointed AFTER the order shipped -- a historical fact, not a defect. Filter these OUT to see the live queue. On production 1,260 of the 1,285 known mismatches are this.
fields.label: Historical Re-pointing

fields.description: The branch that actually shipped the order. This is the fact — do not "fix" the invoice to match the territory.
fields.label: POS Profile Used (shipped)

fields.description: The branch the invoice's Territory points at. When this disagrees with the branch that shipped, this is usually what needs correcting.
fields.label: Territory POS Profile (expected)

fields.description: The Territory the invoice actually carried. Blank for a Territory Unresolved exception.
fields.label: Invoice Territory

fields.description: Best guess at the Territory this order should have carried, from the shipping address, or from the only Territory pointing at the shipping branch. May be blank when nothing unambiguous could be derived.
fields.label: Expected Territory

fields.description: Snapshot of Address.city as it read when the exception was raised. Free text on this site, not a Territory name.
fields.label: Address City

fields.description: Everything a reviewer needs to act without opening the invoice.
fields.label: Detail

name: Jarz Territory Exception
